typography.headline: Bold geometric sans-serif (e.g. Sora, Poppins Bold)
typography.body: Clean readable sans-serif (e.g. Inter, Poppins Regular)

designSystem.iconography: Consistent line-art icon style, uniform stroke width, one accent color per track drawn from trackPalettes.

externalAssetConvention.purpose: Flags slides whose visualDirective calls for a real photo, not an icon/diagram.
externalAssetConvention.rule: Any slide without an externalAsset field uses the icon/diagram default.

audioConvention.purpose: Each post carries a content-matched mood + search terms for picking a trending audio track at publish time.
audioConvention.rule: Do not hardcode a specific trending track — trends are ephemeral. Use searchTerms in the platform's trending-audio picker.
